hot_spots.reason: Zero sentinel from computeRatioX96 overflow bypasses maxSqrtPriceX96 check. Architecturally latent — not reachable from CLOB pipeline (uint128 cap + price bounds prevent overflow).

Key computation mismatch: _storeNonTokenHookFees hashes (tokenFor, tokenFor) but _transferHookFeesByHook hashes (tokenFor, tokenFee). API footgun for custom hooks, but current codebase only uses tokenFor==tokenFee path.
All state-modifying CLOB functions are nonReentrant guarded. Settlement restricted to AMM-only caller. Robust against re-entrancy and unauthorized access.

ruled_out_vectors.title: feeOnTop unsigned in SWAP_TYPEHASH — intentional design
ruled_out_vectors.description: feeOnTop fields excluded from SWAP_TYPEHASH. By design — limitAmount caps total exposure.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — user's limitAmount bounds net received amount regardless of fee manipulation.
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: SWAP_TYPEHASH_STUB in Constants.sol excludes feeOnTop. limitAmount check in _executeFillOrKillPermit:216 and _executePartialFillPermit:319 protects user.

ruled_out_vectors.title: computeRatioX96 overflow returns zero sentinel — not reachable from CLOB
ruled_out_vectors.description: computeRatioX96 returns 0 on uint160 overflow, which would bypass maxSqrtPriceX96 bound. CLOB pipeline caps orderAmount at uint128.max and prices at [MIN_SQRT_RATIO, MAX_SQRT_RATIO], preventing overflow.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — CLOB-derived parameters never produce values large enough to overflow.
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: CH02OverflowTest.t.sol: uint128.max at MAX_SQRT_RATIO computes ratio without overflow (returned 1.46e48, not 0). MIN_SQRT_RATIO also safe.

ruled_out_vectors.title: 100% fee asymmetry between input and output swaps
ruled_out_vectors.description: Hypothesis: fee logic treats input/output swaps asymmetrically at 100% fee. Analysis: (inputSwap && feeBPS > MAX_BPS) || feeBPS >= MAX_BPS simplifies to feeBPS >= MAX_BPS. No asymmetry.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — boolean expression evaluation confirms symmetric rejection at 100% fee.
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: Truth table analysis: when feeBPS >= MAX_BPS, second disjunct is true regardless of inputSwap. Both paths reject equally.

ruled_out_vectors.title: ERC-777 re-entrancy during CLOB settlement
ruled_out_vectors.description: ERC-777 tokensReceived callback during CLOB settlement could re-enter. All CLOB entry points use nonReentrant modifier.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — nonReentrant modifier prevents re-entrancy on all state-modifying functions.
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: All state-modifying functions (openOrder, closeOrder, ammHandleTransfer, afterSwapRefund) have nonReentrant. ERC-777 callback hits the guard.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Partial fill feeOnTop exploitation via ratio manipulation
ruled_out_vectors.description: Hypothesis: manipulate partial fill ratio to extract excess feeOnTop. Ratio check at line 319-326 ensures (amountOut * amountInMax >= amountIn * amountOutMax). limitAmount further caps user exposure.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — ratio check + limitAmount create dual protection.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Division by zero in SqrtPriceCalculator
ruled_out_vectors.description: Zero denominator in sqrt calculation. computeRatioX96 checks amountIn > 0 at line 30. calculateFixedInput uses mulDiv which reverts on zero divisor.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — explicit zero checks and FullMath revert protection.
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: test_H06_divisionByZeroDenominatorCalculation in AuditAuthForgerKLoop.t.sol verifies revert on zero input.

ruled_out_vectors.title: afterSwapRefund re-entrancy during partial fill
ruled_out_vectors.description: afterSwapRefund could be called during partial fill to steal refund. Function has nonReentrant guard and caller check.
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: afterSwapRefund is nonReentrant and checks msg.sender == amm. Cannot be called by attacker directly.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Protocol fee collection uses storage not balanceOf
ruled_out_vectors.description: Protocol fees tracked via internal storage accounting, not vulnerable to balanceOf manipulation via donation/flash.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — storage-based accounting immune to external balance manipulation.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Fill-or-kill requires zero fees — design constraint, not vulnerability
ruled_out_vectors.description: Fill-or-kill mode checks amountIn >= requestedAmount, but fees reduce effective amount. This is a design constraint — users choosing fill-or-kill accept that fee recipients cannot extract via feeOnTop because limitAmount caps it.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — limitAmount check at line 216-224 ensures user gets at least limitAmount net.
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: Design analysis: fill-or-kill amountIn check + limitAmount provide dual protection.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Hook callback access control enforced by AMM module
ruled_out_vectors.description: Hook callbacks can only be triggered by the AMM itself. Direct calls from external accounts are rejected.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — AMM validates caller before invoking hook callbacks.
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: test_C1_hookCallbackAccessControl in AuditAuthForgerKLoop.t.sol confirms external calls revert.

ruled_out_vectors.title: CLOB settlement caller restricted to AMM
ruled_out_vectors.description: ammHandleTransfer checks msg.sender == amm, preventing unauthorized settlement.
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: test_C2_CLOBSettlementCallerCheck and test_C11_directCLOBCallBlocked in AuditAuthForgerKLoop.t.sol confirm unauthorized calls revert.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Permit replay protection via PermitC bitmap nonces
ruled_out_vectors.description: Permit2 replay protection handled by PermitC's bitmap nonce system + cosigner validation chain.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — nonce bitmap prevents double-use of permits.
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: test_C3_permitReplayProtection in AuditAuthForgerKLoop.t.sol confirms replay protection.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Cross-chain permit replay blocked by chain ID in domain separator
ruled_out_vectors.description: EIP-712 domain separator includes chainId, preventing cross-chain replay of permits.
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: test_C21_crossChainPermitReplayBlocked in AuditAuthForgerKLoop.t.sol confirms chain ID protection.

ruled_out_vectors.title: swapExtraData malformed input uses defaults silently
ruled_out_vectors.description: swapExtraData not exactly 32 bytes causes silent default usage. Not a vulnerability — caller pays gas for their own mistake.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — self-inflicted configuration error, no value extraction possible.

ruled_out_vectors.title: CLOB order nonce auto-increment prevents replay
ruled_out_vectors.description: CLOB orders use auto-incrementing nonce per maker. Cannot replay old orders.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None — monotonic nonce prevents order replay.
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: test_C8_openOrderNonceAutoIncrement in AuditAuthForgerKLoop.t.sol verifies nonce increment.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Non-token hook fee key mismatch — API footgun for future hooks
ruled_out_vectors.description: _storeNonTokenHookFees hashes key as (tokenFor, tokenFor) but _transferHookFeesByHook hashes (tokenFor, tokenFee). Mismatch only matters when tokenFor != tokenFee. Current codebase never uses divergent paths — fees always collected in same token.
ruled_out_vectors.impact: None in current codebase. Would cause fee loss for custom hooks collecting fees in a different token.
ruled_out_vectors.proof_sketch: Code analysis of both functions. All hook implementations use tokenFor == tokenFee. API footgun for future integrators only.

hypothesis_results.detail: Non-token hook fee key mismatch (_storeNonTokenHookFees hashes tokenFor,tokenFor vs _transferHookFeesByHook hashes tokenFor,tokenFee) is an API footgun but not exploitable — current codebase always uses tokenFor == tokenFee. No profit vector.

validateHandlerOrder zero-price bypass when computeRatioX96 overflows to 0. Architecturally latent — CLOB caps orderAmount at uint128.max and prices at [MIN_SQRT_RATIO, MAX_SQRT_RATIO]. CH02OverflowTest proves no overflow for CLOB-reachable parameters. No profit vector.
100% fee logic: (inputSwap && feeBPS > MAX_BPS) || feeBPS >= MAX_BPS simplifies to feeBPS >= MAX_BPS. No asymmetry between input and output swaps. No profit vector.
ERC-777 re-entrancy during CLOB settlement blocked by nonReentrant modifier on all state-modifying functions (openOrder, closeOrder, ammHandleTransfer, afterSwapRefund). No profit vector.
Partial fill feeOnTop manipulation blocked by dual protection: ratio check (amountOut * amountInMax >= amountIn * amountOutMax) + limitAmount caps net received. No profit vector.
SqrtPriceCalculator overflow-to-zero not reachable from CLOB pipeline. uint128.max at MAX_SQRT_RATIO produces ratio 1.46e48, well within uint160 range. CH02OverflowTest proves this.
afterSwapRefund re-entrancy during partial fill blocked by nonReentrant + AMM-only caller check. Attacker cannot call afterSwapRefund directly.
Protocol fee collection uses storage-based accounting in _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse. Not vulnerable to balanceOf manipulation via donation/flash loan.
Fill-or-kill with feeOnTop is a design constraint. limitAmount check ensures user receives at least limitAmount net regardless of fee setting. Not a vulnerability.
Multi-hop fee interaction is correct arithmetic. Each hop applies fees independently; no compounding error or extraction opportunity across hops.
